signInDescription: Use the email and password for your Aqarak account.
signUpDescription: Create your account to start setting up your company.
verifyDescription: Enter the six-digit code sent to your email.
companyDescription: Choose how you manage properties and enter your company details.
passwordPolicy: At least 12 characters, with upper and lower case letters, a number and a symbol
passwordManagers: Paste and password managers work here. No one-time codes.
invitation: Owners, tenants and technicians join by invitation from their management company.
statement: One record for owners, tenants and contracts. Every change has a name, a time and a reason.
mockNotice: This service is running with synthetic demo accounts.
confirmed: Your email is confirmed. Sign in to continue.
consequence: You will be this company's administrator. You can invite your team next.
emailHint: Enter the email address you use for this account.
nameHint: Enter your full name as you want your team to see it.
codeHint: Use the latest six-digit email code.
companyNameHint: Use the company name in the indicated language.
licenceHint: Required for a property management company.
INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is not correct.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
UNAVAILABLE: We could not reach Aqarak. Check your connection and try again.
EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
PASSWORD_POLICY: At least 12 characters, with upper and lower case letters, a number and a symbol
VALIDATION_FAILED: Check this field and try again.

pendingInvitation: You have a pending invitation. Review it before creating a company.
